arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
arguments.explanation: This counts all transactions dated in 2019. The data runs only to the end of October 2019, so that is where the count stops.
assumptions: I took "this year" to mean 2019, because the data ends on 2019-10-31. The count covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, as there is no data after that.
The count includes every transaction, whether or not it has a fraud label and whatever its amount (negative amounts too).
